parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no member records (`"members": []`) and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `shared_ancestor`) are null. Without any field-level or method-level evidence to compare `PlaycutMetadataService.MetadataError` against `HTTPStreamError`, there is no grounded basis for recommending a refactor. The two types live in separate packages (`Shared/Metadata` and `Shared/Playback`) and their names suggest domain-specific error enumerations whose structural resemblance, if any, is likely coincidental rather than a sign of shared semantics worth unifying.
